notes.notes:
[h2]Meta with SteamVR Streaming Fixes[/h2]

We've added tweaks to improve SteamVR streaming performance for a smoother experience.

If you still encounter FPS drops, jittering hands, or image stuttering while using Meta + SteamVR:

[list]
[*] Set Graphics presets to LOW.
[*] Adjust [b]Render Resolution[/b] in the Settings (e.g., set it to 90% for a ~10% performance boost).
[/list]
We strive to support all VR devices and launch options, continuously improving third-party solutions launch. However, we still recommend [b]using native Oculus streaming, like AirLink[/b], to minimize additional FPS loss — VR is already demanding on hardware!

[b]Let us know how these updates work for you![/b]

[h2]HBAO is still under development[/h2]
We've been working hard to integrate this graphics-enhancing technology into Hard Bullet, but we encountered some performance issues, particularly with Meta via SteamVR streaming.

While we aimed to have HBAO ready this year, we want to ensure a smooth experience for all our players. Therefore, we've decided to postpone its release until January.

Thanks and sorry for waiting!

[h2]Bugfixes and Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Graphics:[/b] Added more precise render scaling, now adjustable in 1% increments.
[*] [b]Graphics: [/b]Introduced an HDR on/off option for enhanced visuals.
[*] [b]Head Bag:[/b] Fixed an issue where the active Head Bag outfit reverted to the default after restarting.
[*] [b]Range:[/b] Updated target destruction sounds for better feedback.
[*] [b]Range: [/b]Improved UI button usability for a smoother experience.
[*] [b]Veteran 88[/b] and some other rifles: Fixed reloading issues.
[/list]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/b6a03c3035bf3174c2bbd556ac1e3ea6d273abf9.png[/img]
Hey everyone!

First of all, [b]happy holidays[/b] to everyone who celebrates it! We hope that you'll have a wonderful Christmas with your loved ones and [b]well deserved holiday! 🎄☃️[/b] [i](we can also use some rest)[/i]

[b]Christmas Update will be our last update for 2024[/b] but expect even more exciting stuff in 2025! Thank you all so much for an amazing year, [b]we really appreciate your support and love![/b]
[hr][/hr]
Let's get right into the update details! 📜

[h2]Real-Time Shadows Everywhere![/h2]
Today, we’re thrilled to introduce some significant visual improvements that elevate the realism and depth of Hard Bullet’s style.

[h3]Real-Time Shadows Update[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/5c1941a59f59226502e96e98e7d3867f2363db2f.png[/img]
We’re excited to introduce real-time shadows for all objects across every arena in Hard Bullet!
[list]
[*] [b]Optimized Performance: [/b]Shadows are designed to have minimal impact on performance.
[*] [b]Customizable Settings:[/b] If you prefer, you can disable real-time shadows in the Graphics Settings menu.[/list]
As this technology is still new for us, you might encounter some visual glitches, particularly in larger arenas like[b] City Roofs[/b]. Rest assured, we’re actively identifying and addressing these issues to ensure a smoother experience.

[h3]Horizon-Based Ambient Occlusion — Still in Work[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/ebaa97cf2b539624f21f61553638fa979a34a254.png[/img]
[b]We planned to include Horizon-Based Ambient Occlusion (HBAO) in today's update, but due to some unexpected issues, we had to postpone its release.
[/b]
This feature [b]will now be added during the next few days[/b], enhancing the realism of lighting and reflections across all physics and static objects in the game.

Thank you for your patience and understanding. Stay tuned for this exciting visual upgrade coming very soon!

[h2]Updated System Requirements and Launch Options[/h2]
[h3]📈 Rising System Requirements[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/83f6a4999625b2c66830248f8f72700ea4f2e35e.png[/img]
To keep up with modern hardware and deliver a smoother gaming experience, we’re phasing out support for older systems:
[list]
[*] [b]Minimum GPU:[/b] GTX 1070.
[*] [b]Recommended GPU:[/b] RTX 2070S (or GTX 1080 Ti).
[*] [b]Minimum CPU:[/b] Intel i5-10400.
[*] [b]Recommended CPU:[/b] Intel i7-10700 or equivalent.
[/list]
These changes reflect the hardware most players already use and prevent confusion for new users looking to match their setup with the game’s needs.
[h3]⚙️ Graphical Settings Presets[/h3]
We also Resolved issues with graphical presets that could prevent them from being applied. Now switching works correctly but restarting the game is still needed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/ff1d6bac4ced0fa107f3e331bcebfb52189da645.png[/img]
We’ve reordered our VR launch options for clarity and convenience:
[list]
[*] [b]Meta Runtime[/b] is now the first launch option.
[*] [b]SteamVR[/b] is the second option.
[/list]
While we recommend using the runtime that corresponds to your headset, we remain fully committed to supporting all available options and HMD combinations.
[h3]🛠 Need Help?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/289e574fe9122c19fc04a533aef724daf8bd6f37.png[/img]
If you experience any launch issues or other technical problems, please reach out to us via [url=https://www.discord.gg/QDrUWsJ]Discord[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1294760/discussions/3/]Steam Forums[/url] or [url=mailto: hello@gexagon.com]Email[/url]. Our team has a strong track record of troubleshooting issues and providing fixes, and we’d love to help resolve your case.

📝 [b]Note:[/b] Posting detailed descriptions of your issues on forums is far more productive than leaving negative reviews without specifics. Your feedback helps us identify and fix problems more efficiently!

Thank you for your continued support — let’s keep making [b]Hard Bullet[/b] better together! 💪
[hr][/hr]
[h2]🎄 Welcome to the Holiday Shooting Range! 🌟[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/914a591e896d32a17c884a975a100329706ac064.gif[/img]

[h2]Replay Halloween Event[/h2]
Thank You for the Amazing Response to Our Halloween Event! 🎃

For those who missed it, we’ve got a treat for you! The Halloween Event is now available to replay in the Betas tab — as many times as you’d like!

✨[b]Your progress is safe![/b] Saves will work both ways, so when you switch back to the main version, all your unlocked gun skins (new and old) will still be with you.

Don’t miss this chance to relive the spooky fun and keep collecting those looks!

[h2]Future Updates and Events[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/18d6466092b1eaa73647e98eb548b3089caa37de.png[/img]
[h3]Replay Other Events[/h3]
As the Winter Event comes to a close later in January, it will join other "classic" Hard Bullet versions in the Betas Tab. This way, you’ll always have access to those nostalgic experiences.
[hr][/hr]
[b]But now, let’s talk about what’s ahead:[/b]

[h3]🚀 The Future of Hard Bullet[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/5feb9ef45beb12432207f7160c4d6654c5a9d466.gif[/img]

[b]2025 will be a pivotal year for Hard Bullet. [/b]The updates we’re working on are monumental, reshaping massive aspects of the game, including:
[list]
[*] Player body, movement, and hand systems.
[*] Revamped enemy AI systems.
[*] [b]Quest 3/3s Standalone.[/b]
[*] A Story/Roguelite Mode.
[/list]
This leap forward is so significant that we’re dedicating ourselves fully to bringing Hard Bullet to the next level. It’s time to prepare for a game that addresses the flaws of its predecessor while embracing the innovation we’ve always envisioned.

So let’s take a moment to appreciate the current version — imperfections and all — and prepare to welcome the next generation of Hard Bullet, [b]free from the limitations of old code and legacy issues.[/b]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]🎉 Thank You & Happy New Year![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/736002ec75102aa5b474799bb2bace8d7d2418d1.png[/img]

[b]We’re deeply grateful for your support over the years.[/b] Your feedback and enthusiasm have made this journey possible.

While the dev team will take a well-deserved break from [b]December 31st to January 10th[/b], bugfix updates will roll out until the end of December. Meanwhile, our marketing team will keep you entertained with exciting content!

[b]Here’s to an amazing 2025 and the future of Hard Bullet — built together with our incredible community! 🙌[/b]

notes.title: Quest Version, Story/Rogue-Lite Mode
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Today, we are here to announce some of our [b]future plans for HARD BULLET[/b] - and some of them being long-time requested features by you. 👀 If you're ready, have some popcorn on us, and let's give it a start with an exciting announcement!

[h2]Meta Quest Version Announcement[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/42723b0532704fb878ed1e10da6dccf501ddcc69.gif[/img]
                                                 [i][b]ALRIGHT ALRIGHT, WE SEE YOU! 👀[/b][/i]

[h2]Footage from Quest 3/3S Standalone Version[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/4184c8003688db5540b29c3fd69203e370210c8e.gif[/img]
We [b]FINALLY [/b]have an answer to your '[i]Quest version?[/i]' questions! 😅

We heard you loud and clear and we are more than happy to announce that [b]we are working on the Meta Quest version of HARD BULLET.[/b]

We are still striving for the best possible performance on [b]Quest 3[/b]. Hard Bullet is known for its intensive CPU and GPU usage, and we're actively working on optimizations. 

This new research and development for Quest are also helping us improve the PC version significantly!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/aa991fb2e27ce72c5647d32bef7fed636bab2f4c.gif[/img]

We plan to maintain all the features available in the PC version, and this includes the violent elements as well. To achieve this, we had to rework how blood behaves in Hard Bullet, which led to a more realistic saturation of fabric with blood and a few additional enhancements that you’ll see in the [b]upcoming PC update.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/eb5e3263e4a79e5b014cd39ad211f350e90fe2bc.gif[/img]
And let's not forget about guns! Our huge collection with detailed gun interactions will be there too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/bc2f37d97d3067cdb80cecc3f11abb9b0b0128fc.gif[/img]

[b]For more information on this Quest version please keep your eyes on the horizon![/b]


[h2]Story and Rogue Elements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/e7137307c618b211c9219c18cef2e7c823c6aa8e.png[/img]

We're excited to announce [b]a new game mode coming in 2025[/b], which was a long-time requested feature from our community - bringing [b]story elements[/b], new gameplay mechanics, enhanced enemy AI, and countless fresh scenarios for you to experience in Hard Bullet.

Our vision is to create a unique, immersive journey through a violent, sprawling megapolis, where each moment is intense and unpredictable. You'll find yourself navigating chaotic city streets, facing brutal challenges, and engaging in high-stakes combat as you move deeper into the heart of the megapolis.

The story will unfold across [b]multiple chapters[/b], set in ever-evolving districts, each with its own atmosphere and encounters. You'll also have the freedom to embark on an endless journey, plunging further into the city's violent underworld to test your skills and endurance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/0496dc8096cfd7cb2ca1393c9fadc3b26e80ed04.gif[/img]


[h2]Random Encounters[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/c33a13dea83d3afbbed4f3b6ccc3e6576da3b0e8.png[/img]
The city's streets are always shifting, ensuring that even during story runs, you'll face [b]fresh encounters[/b] with every playthrough. We are working on [b]a variety of intense scenarios[/b] to showcase the brutal reality of life in the backstreets and the violent power struggles that spill into the luxurious high-rises of the city center.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/cb37829cf19d92dcafb36bcf5efcd99b6c1c4358.gif[/img]

You'll cross paths with dangerous figures and find yourself in [b]harrowing situations[/b] — gangsters torturing debt collectors, underground human trafficking rings, drug labs hidden in plain sight, and secret arms deals taking place at dark alleys. Meanwhile, the local police struggle to keep up, often turning a blind eye as criminal powers dominate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/9e4d43fd29c99cb1abfd6e2390c74e4ea8be5670.gif[/img]

As a third-party contract killer, you'll have the freedom to decide where your loyalties lie. You can aid both factions, playing them against each other, or stay focused on your own mission, passing through the chaos as you pursue your primary target. [b]The choice is yours.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/3be5c4c93c810fc66b008329166c181a41fe285e.png[/img]


[h2]Districts[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/960420838b49e8915f9551a6c39d84e41b6e1926.png[/img]
We're currently developing two city districts for you to explore, each with its own distinct design, staying true to Hard Bullet's brutal style.

[list]
[*] [b]Backstreets District[/b] will immerse you into the city's dark corners, street markets, and poor quarters The Backstreets District will pull you deep into the city's shadowy underbelly, filled with dark alleys, crowded street markets, and impoverished neighborhoods. Here, gangsters of every stripe run their violent operations, from extortion to smuggling, creating a chaotic environment where no witnesses are welcome.

[*] [b]The Rooftops District [/b]offers a stark contrast, taking you to the heights of the city—luxury penthouses and towering skyscrapers, where those in power hide dark secrets. With a focus on vertical exploration, you'll navigate rich indoor environments while balancing perilous runs along the rooftops' edges, where one wrong move could send you plummeting to the streets below.[/list]
[h2]Nearest Updates[/h2]

As for the upcoming updates, we are working hard to bring you these [b]next week:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Performance Improvements[/b] — managed to get a huge FPS boost again, can't wait to share the details.
[*] [b]Reworked some gore aspects[/b] of the game to make blood and inner bones look more realistic.
[*] Enemies will get [b]more firearms[/b] to use.[/list]
[b]What an entrance to October huh? 👀[/b] We are so excited about everything we have announced today and can not wait for you to get your hands on them! 

We couldn't be inspired this much if it wasn't for you, [b]our community[/b]. Thank you so much for all your support and patience while we are cooking for the future of HARD BULLET. 🙌

notes.title: 🚀 Performance Update, Explosives, Player Customization & MORE!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We are more than happy to share with you our latest update to HARD BULLET which mainly brings a [b]huge performance boost, deeper player customization, and endless RIDE mode![/b]

[h2]⚒️ Stability & Performance[/h2]

Long-waited performance update is here! We have worked hard on a more optimized experience and this update should bring a [b]significant FPS and performance boost[/b] for everyone.

Let us compare some numbers for nerds out there!

[u][b]BEFORE:[/b][/u] 4 puppets, 60FPS

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/ed8a49410ef84cd7b8dbbc8edd7f08364dcfb793.png[/img]

[u][b]AFTER:[/b][/u] 5 puppets, 90FPS

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/f8bc49aa0e8e5279623ee14d8424d00e9eaf23b6.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Puppets Optimized:[/b] We have worked hard on optimizing the enemies to afford more puppets on arenas bringing up to a [b]50% FPS boost to some systems.[/b]
[*] [b]Game engine to Unity Il2CPP:[/b] This new experimental way of game build brings us some good [b]FPS boost and stability[/b]. Expect [b]10% to 20%[/b] performance improvements in all locations. 
[/list]
This performance update makes the overall gameplay experience much smoother for every player. Please feel free to give us your feedback as always, we will be looking into them!
[list]
[*] [b]New Cooling:[/b] Using a new cooling system that brought some decent [b]performance boost.[/b]
[*] [b]Resolution Scale Option:[/b] Sometimes simply lowering the overall resolution scale by 5-10% can bring a significant FPS boost. We recommend you play with this option to raise or lower overall visual game quality.[/list]
[h2]🧤Player Customization[/h2]
Rise and shine everyone! It's time to show your unique style to those enemies.[list]

[*] We've added a new player customization feature! Now, you can mix and match several suits, heads, and gloves when playing in full-body mode. If you're using hands-only mode, you can enjoy the new glove appearances.
[*] You can [b]change your outfit using the mirror[/b] in the Lobby![/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/9ba22a8032c90342f5fd2ab888446163be1eefb9.gif[/img]

[h2]💣 Explosive Objects[/h2]
[b]Expanding the category[/b] — explosive objects like barrels and gas canisters are here! After getting a shot, the liquid inside starts burning so you have a little time to get away or throw it somewhere.

Just make sure to [b]keep your distance[/b], will you?  Or don't, your choice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/5187cdc53ba2c00d14ac4ba4dfd02465cb3aef56.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/308e9217d806ba5112d0c9590d6c0941471de9b8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/e91405b3f4631d48036d1f4f2aae2d4de72ad0ab.gif[/img]
[list][*] There are eight new explosive objects of various sizes and effects. You can find them throughout the locations and in the Explosives tab of the Hand Spawner Menu.[/list]
[h2]⚔️Endless RIDE[/h2]
[list][*] Now [b]RIDE is an endless experience[/b], so after finishing it, you can continue playing and unlocking new weapons. The progress saves every time you finish the arena or die, so you can give a break anytime you would like to [b]without losing anything you have unlocked.[/b][/list]
[h3]More Gun Visuals![/h3]
[list][*] Now most firearms in the armory have unlockable visuals — today we have added [b]50 more looks[/b] for the 12 guns that did not have them before![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/129c9683b81f8348fae09bc76ee38b197b64316f.png[/img]
[h3]Challenges, Unlocks, Updated UI[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/470b3441e8b13262356d1a94effb93549006db02.gif[/img]

We've updated the main Progression UI with a reworked Challenges Tab. It now includes information about three unlock categories: Gun, Player, and Arena.
[list][*][b]Gun and Player Challenges:[/b] These will unlock new weapons or player appearances.
[*][b]Arena Challenges:[/b] A collection of different challenges.
[/list]
There is no need to jump into Arena challenges right away — we recommend just keep playing Hard Bullet and you'll get them all eventually. No need to rush, take your time! 🕒

[b]We plan to add more unlockable content and additional rewards[/b] for completing these challenges in the future. Keep your eyes on the horizon!

[h3]Save System Updated[/h3]
We've reworked the save system to better manage player progress and unlocks. Your progress will transfer smoothly, so no worries.

However, [b]if you roll back to older versions of Hard Bullet, you may lose your weapon unlock progress [/b]unless you make a copy of your save file before downgrading.

[b]Your save file is located here:[/b]
[code]C:\Users\WINDOWS USER NAME\AppData\LocalLow\GexagonVR\Hard Bullet[/code]

[h3]New Lighting[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/5807df3442429b8fc275f047492bf81908b27418.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] A new lighting system has been added — dark areas are darker, and colorful lights now blend and mix beautifully on the walls.
[*] Metal objects also feature additional reflections.
[/list]
So, to sum it all up, we not only achieved [b]significant FPS improvements[/b] and stability but also enhanced the in-game graphics with [b]much more realistic lighting[/b].


[h3]Damage Across the Enemy Body[/h3]
Your chance to have critical damage on the enemy is now here! Here's a quick guide to show you how damage is distributed across the enemy's body.
[list]
[*] [b]Head and Neck:[/b] Critical damage, 500%
[*] [b]Torso:[/b] 100% damage
[*] [b]Upper Arms and Thighs:[/b] 70% damage
[*] [b]Wrist-Elbow and Lower Knee Zones:[/b] 60% damage
[*] [b]Hands and Feet:[/b] 50% damage[/list]
With legs and hands now taking less damage, fights with heavily armored enemies will be [b]tougher[/b]. Time for a new strategy!

[h3]Other Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Armory: [/b]Weapons are now arranged according to their unlock order.
[*] [b]Holster Offsets:[/b] Fixed a bug where the checkbox was removed after loading into a new arena.
[*] [b]Enemy Helmets:[/b] Fixed an issue where enemy helmets could not be knocked off if violence was turned off.
[*] [b]Fire Rate Selectors:[/b] Set to automatic where needed on guns.
[*] [b]Bullet Pusher:[/b] Fixed an issue where the bullet pusher could get stuck even with an empty mag on some pistols.
[*] [b]Flashlight Intensity:[/b] Reduced the flash intensity from bullet impacts on metal surfaces.
[/list]
[b]Current game version: EA 0.7.4.32[/b]

[h3]Older Hard Bullet Versions[/h3]
Feeling a little bit nostalgic? We prepared some older game builds to play as many of you wanted to check how HB evolved over the years.

notes.title: Firearms Update: Gun Weight, Inertia, New Recoil, Spread and Impact effects
notes.notes:
Second major update, huh? Those who participated in our Public Beta test already have an idea of what's coming. Thank you to everyone who took the time to help us test the new physics and weapon inertia during last month.


[h2]Firearms Updated[/h2]
[h3]Weight & Inetria[/h3]
We've added noticeable weight and inertia to all weapons. Now, it won't be as easy to quickly wave big, heavy guns in your hands, making gameplay and handling more realistic.

[h3]Recoil & Spread[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/d870c9b9be4522694b60309d693fcbc718e604aa.gif[/img]

We've updated the recoil and spread for all Hard Bullet weapons, adjusting the recoil for both one-handed and two-handed grips. Now all firearms has their own spread pattern too. 

[b]Summing up the significant improvements to the firearms in Hard Bullet:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Unique Spread and Recoil:[/b] Each firearm now has its own spread pattern and recoil.
[*] [b]Extensive Collection:[/b] Nearly 100 firearms in the game.
[*] [b]Unique Characteristics:[/b] Each gun features unique sounds, spread patterns, and recoil.
[*] [b]Realistic Handling:[/b] Guns now have weight and handle differently.
[/list]
[b]Balancing all these elements is a complex task and we hope you will be impressed with the results![/b]


[h2]Other Weapon Updates[/h2]
[h3]Lights on Impact[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/e2929346c54de16530be1d9971c987093224704b.gif[/img]

Added a quick real-time light effect to particles when bullets hit metallic surfaces. It shouldn't impact performance significantly, but if you experience FPS drops, you can turn it off in the Graphics settings.

[h3]New and updated guns[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/023510a1dd170104c7c58939e9e5f411349e3e9c.png[/img]

[b]Automatic 12 gauge[/b]
[list]
[*] Sisu — grandfather of all automatic shotguns.
[*] Wicked  — don't hesitate, Mr. Wick.
[/list]
[b]7.62 Rifles[/b]
[list]
[*] Rupert Mini
[*] Coyote
[/list]
[b]Three more guns have been updated with new highly detailed models:[/b]
[list]
[*] CS75 — deadly eastern handgun in all its beauty.
[*] Samuel 911
[*] Muller 45 SMG
[*] Maverick — new model, kept the old shell holsters for now.
[*] Moss Shorty — came to change older low-poly Cruiser shotgun.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/da3f413e26fc9da68cf00946e8d21fad5477b83a.png[/img]

[h3]Adjusted Weapon Unlock Order[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/8a8c7933b5697b3d0bf2c7868f8564ca00516311.gif[/img]

Slightly changed weapon unlock order in RIDE to make it more balanced. This will prevent overwhelming players with new weapons and gradually add new ones to the collection.

The changes are minor, so they won't affect early- or late-game players and should be smooth for those at mid-level too.


[h2]Player Body[/h2]
[h3]Elbows Physics Changes[/h3]
Elbow physics is now off by default. After research, we've concluded that additional physics simulation in players' elbows isn't necessary for most of our players, because mostly firearms and melee weapons are used to kill bots.

Today, we're adding a new option to Player's Body Settings. You can now choose between two full body modes:
[list]
[*] The old mode with elbow physics.
[*] A new mode with a visible full body model but only hand physics, similar to most VR physics games.
[/list]
If you prefer close combat martial arts gameplay, you can switch on the old mode to deal damage and push enemies with your elbows. For the rest of the players, the "no elbow physics" mode will be the default. This should reduce instances of elbows getting stuck and improve movement through locations.

[h3]We recommend all Hard Bullet players choose the No Elbow Physics option to enhance your shooting experience.[/h3]

[h3]Mirror Feature[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/060b99ea71ba6ca22b1239ad64ca0743757d2982.gif[/img]

Can ragdolls recognize themselves in the mirror? That's the question we're going to answer today!

We've added a work-in-progress mirror, currently available only in the Lobby location. In future updates, we plan to add more features to it, including the ability to switch between different outfits without needing to visit Player Settings in the menu.

[h2]Other Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where enemy weapons could disappear in the player's hands, causing the hands to get stuck in the air.
[*] Arena Spawns: Fixed Starways and Rooftop waves menu.
[*] Inner code refactoring for Armory and UIs.
[/list]
[b]Current game version: EA 0.6.3.11[/b]

[h2]Nearest Development Plans[/h2]
[list]
[*]We're working on new baked lighting to enhance the atmosphere in our locations. While GIFs can't fully capture how gorgeous it will be, they should give you a small preview.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/b3568a9e9595d3c718f3d5f7485d64acd8eba34d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/7280dca14d66f197f596fcf1d88ef67b8a5bcea4.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]Working on new outfits and gloves for player model.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/e9c88aceb7c56c8b0aeb3af8c02b5d8bf21c1258.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]We're starting work on optimization and player body improvements. This complex process will take the entire summer, but we have big plans to significantly improve FPS and player movement.
[*]Work on Challenges is progressing well, and we plan to roll them out in the next update this summer.
[/list]

notes.notes:
[h2]New Waves Mode[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/44cf19ca80dce4d0f170fc985115929278ba5076.png[/img]

Hello everyone, today we're excited to introduce a refreshed version of the 2020 Waves mode, along with a new layout for the Wave Spawner.

You now have the option to select from two game modes: Survival (previously known as Waves since 2021) and the newly designed Waves mode, which offers a more structured gameplay experience.

We offer three difficulty settings determined by the number of waves, but as always, you're free to set your own. Additionally, the Player Settings remain available for those who want to add an extra challenge by trying different health modes (check out NEW No Regen mode!) and ammunition level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/c3163d710a69570500a922b66ea6726fc5aae287.png[/img]

Expect to face waves of enemies with different outfits, all created using the game's current assets. We're excited about our plans to introduce diverse enemy body types and movement patterns in upcoming updates.

[h3]Light Shooter[/h3]
These enemies wield standard pistols and have no armor. Esay peasy.

[h3]Spec Ops[/h3]
These are more formidable opponents. Dressed in black, they use SMGs and are protected by light armor. A well-aimed shot can knock off their masks and helmets.

[h3]Heavy Assault[/h3]
Armed with assault rifles and wearing heavy armor, these enemies are tough to take down. You'll likely use up an entire magazine to penetrate their armor, so it's better to target their unprotected body parts or engage them at close range with a blade.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/1c02590cd3ed996b6dc23a219461bca1a28434a7.gif[/img]


[h2]Shotgun: Pump Logic Updated[/h2]
Updating the mechanics for pump shotguns to make them more realistic when you run out of ammo. Here's what happens when you fire the last shell and pull the pump handle back:
[olist]
[*] The pump of the empty shotgun will stay in the open position, leaving the action chamber visible and indicating the weapon is out of ammo.
[*] You'll need to insert a new shell into the chamber and then slide the pump handle forward to load the round.
[*] After that, you can continue to load more shells into the magazine tube, located at the lower part of the shotgun.
[/olist]
[strike]Known Issue: after loading one round, pump moves forward in free mode, ignoring user pump settings. Hotfix is on its way.[/strike] [b]Fixed.[/b]


[h2]Market and Dead End Updated[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/75ff7916eaf7c41bc3b93fb76560202f7802fd28.gif[/img]

We've enriched the Dead End sandbox with additional details, refined enemy pathways, and fixed colliders. We've also introduced more elements in the environment that you can interact with, such as items you can grab or remove with a shot.

The market arena has been enhanced with parts that can be detached, although this location is still being refined. 

Over the next few months, we're committed to releasing updates for our arenas, continuously improving your gaming experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/cd8529aa588097c6657b867d2c5bba8435857bd4.png[/img]

We acknowledge the inconvenience and are planning more comprehensive internal changes. A fix is in the works, and we aim to roll it out soon to prevent such issues from occurring in the future. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/b9aec2b0d64fd047b8c4992a068b2344a1959fb5.jpg[/img]

Custom poses for all game firearms are here! No more wacky grabs, clipping fingers and other immersion-breaking visual glitches. Hold your guns like you should.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/80ea5fd98bc3dca52836ea06dc32c97be9e99b35.jpg[/img]


[h2]Sound Updates[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/31f7ced08bf25ba8470778337daece58ec07ec10.png[/img]
It took a while but we finally find a new partner to help us with sounds — [b]Volkov Studio[/b]! Check out their [url=https://www.youtube.com/@VolkovStudio ]Youtube[/url] or [url=http://volkovstudio.com]website[/url].

Guys already did a good job with break-actions and are adding brand new sounds for Hard Bullet revolvers today.

This is just the start as sound team is full of great ideas and clever solutions, so prepare to hear some changes in the future updates!


[h2]Other Bugfixes & Improvements:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/fa34306bd0a183536773b980987f8f36c71c2ce7.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Revolvers: Added Recoil;
[*] Revolvers: Added two new revolvers — Bodyguard and Rhino;
[*] Pistols: Now can be hold for the second hand grab point alone;
[*] Gore: 9mm deal more visible damage to enemy head;
[*] Gore: Shotgun body damage effect depth increased;

[*] Armory: Tuned distance to show/hide weapons on stands;
[*] UI: Added a scroll element to some Settings tabs;

Our try in large arenas like City Rooftops gone quite well so we decided to move further and started working on new game mode with working title Raid. *It does not mean we want you to assult somehting, it just sounds nice.

notes.title: Bugfixes & Improvements for Big Sandbox Update
Big Sandbox Update: Break Action Rifles, Large Sandbox and More!
notes.notes:
[h1]Big Sandbox Update[/h1]
[h2]New Sandbox Arena[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/47bc29d32109adea35fdd2bad580ccedc17f1dfa.gif[/img]

Present you the biggest Hard Bullet map yet — Sandbox arena under open night sky at rooftops!

[b]Torture Rooftop[/b] with all the fun things brought together:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/ca2c2956cc12a4dcd58284b6cca914d8581f94f6.jpg[/img]

[b]Enemy Spawing[/b] area for cool shootouts. Wave Spawner will activate all the spawning locations at once, so be prepared.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/1a18951efec744e5176c03e09d3c80f4041eecd1.jpg[/img]

[b]Creative Zone[/b] with welding and large Zero-G field. As the one at small sandbox, Zero-G works only with non-organic objects. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/6a9098f8bd486b36f1d18a7461564c304308c439.gif[/img]

Separate zone with [b]melee weapons[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/6c52fa4e006cc72a241c39f9dfc337bceb292405.jpg[/img]


[h2]Spawner available on all arenas[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/f6803477995db4e120625d6e5e475e518c842e71.jpg[/img]

Now object spawner can be used on all arenas, so basically any map can become a Sandbox! 
Prepare location before starting a fight, or just have fun with puppets — its up to you.

Welding Tool was added to Spawner too, you can find it in the Others tab.


[h2]Enemy AI Options[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/6015dde610636ecea7fa13c41ec4eea8b2b4d9ed.jpg[/img]

We added a few enemy presets to Spawner Menu with direct AI controls:
[list]
[*] Enemy spawns with different gun types on/off;
[*] Calm AI that will ignore everything you do to him;
[*] AI that will attack if recieves significant damage;
[*] Button to make everyone angry at you immediately;
[/list]

[h2]Arena Selector in Pause Menu[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/29249f7a3b53fcb09ddcc7258164b55277fc6c7a.jpg[/img]

Choose any map you want to go to from the Pause Menu. No need to go through lobby when you are having so much fun on arenas!


[h2]Ammo Workbench Updated[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/ca1e087eecccf3d628f8572b6e31d2263a982636.gif[/img]

No need to use Magazine as a separate object anymore — just set the prop you want to use as ammo, tune it if needed and make your gun shoot endlessly with those! Reload as usual — gun won't loose its magic and will always load with the prop you chose.


[h1]Break Action Rifles[/h1]
[h2]New weapon type — Break Action[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/1b0541f6ccc551231e95407ec910d8d2aebaf745.gif[/img]

As you know, we love physics so we could not give you weapons that won't physically open/close with your own hands. Happy to present you our first solution for such realistic interactions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/0f255c918c9a9b50e360703eb2fdf70bcadbdfcc.gif[/img]

First, the easy part — you can just open/close the barrels when you press B (drop mag) button, just like it is in every other VR shooter that have break actions. You can close barrel with a rapid hand movement too.

[b]Now the real deal: use both hands to open and close barrels.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/26880c3a3f5c4883f2a537a7852292da230439ff.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Keep your main hand still and grab the barrel with your second hand; 
[*] Pull the barrel down to "breake" it like in real life;
[/list]
[b]Notice:[/b] main hand that holds the handle should not move at all! Keep it in one place, no need to move it down too. Use only your second hand.

It may take a few minutes to figure out how to physicaly open barrels with two hands, no worries if you did not make it from the first try — [b]you always can use B (drop mag) button on your controllers to instantly open and close[/b]. 

There are a few options (the same the shotguns have) so you can choose to press the trigger on your second hand, when "breaking" the barrel to exclude unwanted openings.

In Arcade reloading, barrels will auto-open when they are empty, just move them near your waist to auto-reload — you only need to close the barrels by moving them up in the air or with the B button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/12ce0c2c4fd19db5dcb96f2c15c8be9d08431eef.jpg[/img]


[h2]New Bullet Type .410[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/4cfd05a74ba656e5459b229d4a7b567287e8d9a1.jpg[/img]

Amid those break action monsters a dangerous snake is hiding — this silver beauty shots with lots of small pallets that grind skin from your opponent, but do not dismember.

Caution: if you decide to "charm" an automatic gun with .410 — your PC may melt because of lots of fast collisions.


[h2]New shots spread for 12 gauge[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added one more pallet to the bullet (now it's 8 like it should be);
[*] Tuned every shotgun in the game to make their shots more realistic depending on the barrel length;
[*] Shotguns won't dismember from far distances anymore;
[/list]

[h2]Updated Gun Models[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/28f45c53e85634bc30c418d72e90e11fafe7923c.jpg[/img]

Managed to update a few models that where not so good, now James, Swiss 226, Scorpio, Ingram and K90 SMG look much better. Also added one more Warther to the family — a compact one.


[h1]UI Improvements[/h1]
[h2]New Map Selector[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/70f3a6733c302507c25e1c985982c873fc4f7c60.jpg[/img]

Reorganized how game modes show up in Lobby, what activities are available and what to expect.

[h2]Show Ammo Option[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/5d78182d616c22bd8897cb79b04a40ba32d9bb20.jpg[/img]
Added an option to show the current ammo amount. It will also highlight if you need to put a bullet into chamber or have few bullets left in the mag.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/9573baf1c2206690bdc3450d4b2ad98c096b0df1.jpg[/img]


[h2]Bugfixes and Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Brought back bullet holes on all objects — where were they before? Who knows! But now they are back;
[*] No more shotgun flights — it was fun, but would become a totall mess when using break actions lol. Use the boosters;
[/list]


[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
Here are some issues we plan to resolve during the nearest small updates:
[list]
[*] LOD glitches at Rooftop Sandbox;
[*] Lack of some sounds and overall sound quality of new guns;
[*] Visual artefacts on some new guns;
[*] Holding new guns for handguard is not so flawless like on older ones;
[/list]

[h2]Grenade Launcher[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/ab487ae8969c059ea83ac8e55863d27c351eaf36.gif[/img]

When shooting from close range, bullet won't detonate but will deadly hit enemies instead.

[h2]Boosters: Drag and Explode[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/5a53ed878f7a0433dada5400b6d47fd31769d3b1.gif[/img]

You can connect multiple Boosters into one group so they will be activated all together at a time. Take two boosters and push them one against another so both get a white contour around them which indicates they are together. You can add as many Boosters as you like.

You can create multiple groups. When holding a chain-connected booster in your hands, it will highlight all the other boosters that are connected.

To start Group Boosters simply start one of them — you can bring an extra booster with you to use it as a group launch button from the distance.
We made some changes in UI to help new users and improved experience of the older.


To start Group Boosters simply start one of them — you can bring an extra booster with you to use it as a group launch button from the distance.

notes.title: Explosive Update Part One: Grenade, Sticky Bomb and Claymore; New Arena
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/f143f904b7e4d170baafe954caa80696c774a92b.gif[/img]
[h2]Frag and Sticky Grenades[/h2]
We made Grenades as simple as in any other VR-shooter, but with some physics updates.

[b]Both types use the same control scheme:[/b]
[list]
[*] Take grenade with one hand. 
[*] With your other hand's Trigger button grab the Pull Ring and take the Pin out.
[*] Throw the grenade and you can see the Lever fly off and the grenade explode.
[/list]
[b]Notice:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can grab and move grenades for the Pull Ring. Rapidly pull it out to activate the detonation.
[*] You can remove the Lever with the hand that holds the grenade — press Trigger to set it free after you took the Pin out.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/993aaa5ddc51fbe2c10d574198e369143350f1fe.gif[/img]

[b]Sticky Grenade[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/a3af6b543a978d634aefe8a900735ab45bcce015.gif[/img]
 
Has visible indication that will start counting last seconds before explosion after you pulled the Pin out and released the Lever. As you may guess, these grenades will stick to anything, even to each other!


[h2]Claymore[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/f2df0e058f341f1b0335c75f61d2ef2fcf202732.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Press Trigger to activate Claymore detectors and legs.
[*] Release Claymore where you want it to stand. Do not worry, it always lands on its legs.
[*] Watch them fly.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/301763fbc3270dc93e9b1dca04d27f19a9c6e9e2.gif[/img]


[h2]Explosives in Ammo Workshop[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/c8e8aee847e6caecfb8b6df64b501f9a3feb3954.gif[/img]

We know you love [b]Custom Ammo[/b] so we decided to tune how different explosives will work with it. And do not forget to set a limitless lifespan of those bullets or they will disappear after a while!

[b]Frags and Claymores[/b] will be activated right after you shoot. Grenades will detonate after a short time and Claymores will stay in alert mode and explode when met with an obstacle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/31f8b17e09075d5e073ba047b3ecebe9c3470ece.gif[/img]

[b]Stickies[/b] won't ignite instantly and may be stored until you shoot them with a regular bullet or remove the Pull Ring by hand.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/5fd84f842c1fae164bfbccdda9ce3764fed0e7e8.gif[/img]


[h2]Explosives in Sandbox Spawner[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/49d4d0c5eb35fa69510318ff017caea4cff911a1.jpg[/img]

Sandbox Spawner Menu works as usual, you will find new and future explosives in the Explosives tab.

To prevent Stickies making a total mess on spawn, a tip is to collect them one-by-one from a big sticky pile — use distant grab!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/69d00a4385e2684b9a1eab9d28166c9b419e2a5c.gif[/img]


[h2]Basement Arena[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/2364c5c67f0ef7f329983f8e860e6289b901a3e1.jpg[/img]
We wanted to show you a new side of Hard Bullet experience — darker and more brutal.

This terrifying basement was inspired by famous thriller and horror movies and creates a unique dread athmosphere. What maniac lived here? What terrible tortures did he commit to his victims?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/8a740285f1043f79c19c2e22c788310f730578e0.jpg[/img]


[h2]New Lighting[/h2]
Added new lighting effects so all arenas got much better look. However, we got some issues with Streaming Camera on OpenVR devices, so for now it will show less saturated image than the player gets in game.

[b]Everything is fine on Meta (Oculus). Working on Fix for OpenVR. Here is a Tip how to reduce this effect on Index, Vives, WMRs etc:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/b008b44a3c239b9ecbe37b503654f382444d4496.png[/img]


[h2]Some Bugfixes[/h2]
Fixed distance grab for Welding Tool and hand pose when holding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/a2bae5e74cd89e9f06a38297e7b83447008c04c4.gif[/img]

New models with moving eyes and new animations will make you question your sanity when putting one of those under a giant drill.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/a63ab7764dbf30e0b1fe04769f6bebbd32a49e27.gif[/img]

Returned blood traces, added volumetric blood particles and endless blood puddles because it was not enought blood before. You can turn those On in the Settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/4592d10aabd8f2f65a3c7c375148a81e1b96b0df.gif[/img]

[h2]New Sandbox[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/121124be14c3af5b5c4b327a329caf41919d6b8d.jpg[/img]

Now Sandbox has several presets in which we can better showcase game mechanics 

To make it easier and more fun for gamers and content makers we decided to include defferent locations into one scene. You can switch between different collections on-the-go and keep spawned enemies with you.

[h3]Enemy Workshop[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/59c96f3685b8d6b457264499118aa0789f4f678e.gif[/img]

You can change enemies size and create true giants or dwarfs. You also can decide if they will stay immortal or will die from damage like regular enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/38c5d55976cfa353a7c5e2db32b94b991404c75a.jpg[/img]

Enemies with scale more than 1.7 will allow you to climb on them:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/749c47789b88938cb85940ec5081b6b1d577bf38.gif[/img]

[h3]Ammo Workshop 2.0[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/fa79804ef38d59e091243225861c1e22883b006b.gif[/img]

With this new Ammo Workshop you'll be able to create more crazy weapons of all sizes. Large pencils and micro pitchforks going to deal a lot of pain to your enemies!
[list]
[*] If object gets bigger it becomes heavier too.
[*] Firearms damage does not scale.
[*] Does not work with enemy limbs yet, will be added later.
[*] Does not work with welded.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/9aadf389a566d894aba49b8e6d3a969223a1a277.jpg[/img]

[h3]Welded Prototypes[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/e81882532bb54e91c29ea9c955176ec6698f9cee.gif[/img]

Results of freaky experiments, these hybrids are anticipating new feature that will come soon. It's not as innovative as others and probably you met welding in other games, but we'll try to bring it to a new level in the next updates.

Until then enjoy those shooting and cutting monsters we created.

[h2]Player Body and New Interactions[/h2]
[h3]Player Body Physics[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/e77cb6cc4920b3ec11ef1183a05287d32ccd3754.gif[/img]
Player's body now has phisical impact on surrounding. It works so well, you do even not need to press grip to climb on some obstacles. However, we still have special climbing things so you'll have even more fun:
[list]
[*] Meat hooks on chains
[*] Rusty Pipes
[*] Big Climbing Scene in Sandbox presets
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/8388b4790edcf42740b1a218aaa84aa1c6f54e0a.gif[/img]

To say more about new body, we also gave special attention how guns work with it. Big gun's buttstock should not interfere your aiming but will hit enemies as usual.

[h3]More Holsters[/h3]
We polished holster mechanic so it almost never allows missclicks and always gives you the gun you wanted from the right place.

Now player has four front holsters — chest and hips — and one on the back.

[h3]Better Distance Grab and UI[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/799b9424906fe098bf1882c8e90e066558752f45.gif[/img]

So many new things needed new interface and user experience improvements. We decided to move closer to regular 2D layouts.

To make Distance Grab mechanic more intuitive we added more presets for better visualisaion of what interactable object you are targeting right now. You can tune how it looks in the settings, even turn it off completely when you are ready.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/61a54ea8d6d777f2dc449b71b48b90a1992f9113.jpg[/img]

[h3]Oculus Runtime[/h3]
For all Oculus users added launch option, so if you have your Oculus device connected, game will ask if should run in native Oculus mode or with SteamVR support.

If you still using Virtual Desktop, you should select SteamVR launch, or just have SteamVR running before launching the game.

We recommend to use official Oculus solutions like Air Link or cable connection.

For all non-Oculus users: if you ever see such option, just select SteamVR launch, obviously.

[h3]Wide FOV Camera[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/f8e363c95b31b2a0ffb6c40f1f47e2900aecac0f.jpg[/img]

We want to thank everyone who creates videos and helps us show Hard Bullet to bigger audience. Whout content creators we won't be able to bring all these innovative features and keep going further.

Hope you all enjoy this new feature!

[h2]Temporal Limitations[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/f68cfcfdb72c1acad492cd56e7133fa39dfa0cbd.jpg[/img]

We tried our best but still not all original Hard Bullet features are here yet. Here is a list of most noticable. They will return rewoked and improved — some are almost here, others will take time.
[list]
[*] No Soundtrack and lack of sounds.
[*] No Destructions.
[strike][*] Blunts do not deal visible damage to skin.[/strike]
[*] Basic Enemy AI.
[*] Inserted mags are not physical.
[strike][*] Most languages removed.[/strike]
[/list]
[h2]Old Hard Bullet stays too[/h2]
We decided to keep old [b]October 20' - March 21' Hard Bullet[/b] available too. Due to new launch options it controls may have issues with Virtual Desktop streaming for Oculus Quest and probably with any other VR hardware too.

You can switch back to old version in the Beta tab, select OldHB and finish download.

[h2]Physics Beta is closed[/h2]
Thanks everyone who participated, that was quite a ride. Happy to see so many new Hard Bullet users, please, join our socials to stay in touch!

notes.title: Physics Update — now in public Beta! New Guns, Enemies and Tricks!
notes.notes:
[h2]Fully Physics based interactions[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/2f41febbc01022df6e66c51076d1c6cea28aa667.gif[/img]

We built complex systems and inventive solutions to bring you one of the most advanced physics setups on the market.

[h2]Complex Gun Physics[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/d00df778e8fcca72a6f1b37745596720920894ff.gif[/img]

Hold guns for any part, perform one handed reloads with shotgans and pistols and any crazy trick you can come up with!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/f717b0b925fbf4559d87433f0788c532c8ee4cdf.gif[/img]

[h2]New enemy system[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/47eeeb354727c93d1bbdf95b3fbb8b0e1264052a.gif[/img]
New optimised ragdolls, death animations, physics interactions and much easier to punch and hit with objects! 

[h2]New Narrative Lobby[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/c4837bcac9e99251b9f9c08c53703e61b15247bf.jpg[/img]

As you know we are working on Story mode for Hard Bullet and the new lobby is much closer to the story we going to tell.

This lair of our pratogonist has several very important points of interest we'd like to talk.

[h3]New Armory Layout[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/1f1a6241adf8a14ab1a4d9d623a4f7fef03b7180.jpg[/img]

Legendary weapons are grouped and we are working on new gun appearence. In the future updates we'll add more variations of how you can navigate and group firearms by types, style, ammo type etc.

Such system will allow us to bring new weapon packs and make more noticable updates for shooting side of Hard Bullet.

[b]Press buttons below the layouts to change them.[/b]

[h3]Level Selector[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/a888c558743fc032380ecfc87d13697ae01c9265.jpg[/img]

Trying to make is more user friendly and add more functionality. Right now only Sandbox, Baths and Action maps are avaliable.

Right now there is [b]no Loading symbol[/b], you just need to wait after you chose the Map. Just stay calm and wait a little, especially if the game is not on SSD. It's loading.

[h2]New WIP Sandbox[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/40001ae31bc2a5c7f03bbc49fabbab10b1720dc6.jpg[/img]

Everything is work-in-progress, we going to improve user experience with every update. 

[h3]Different level presets. [/h3]
We made a couple of presets to showcase a sandbox level as we see it.
To make it better and more fun for gamers and content makers we decided to include defferent location into one scene that you can controll.

Right now you can switch between different objects collections on-the-go, try different outfits on a special puppet (soon will be for all), try new guns we are working on. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/070c0c6a7fb0ee858be067d214ac5918dd57cbba.gif[/img]

[h3]Weapons and Melee collection[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/e905a25f79dff72030a264c75a21508232dd93b3.jpg[/img]

We are proud to present not only greately improved weapons and melee mechanics but also whole new world of guns, blades and blunts we are adding.

[h3]Climbing Mechanic[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/e77cb6cc4920b3ec11ef1183a05287d32ccd3754.gif[/img]

Now, when player has fully physical body, you can perform all kind of physics experiments!
You can climb obslacles even without pressing grab button — Just try it yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/adbd20c005fc7c974035a69d2260d94987343a93.gif[/img]

[h2]Known Issues and Tips for better experience[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/768f0574c43afec9259cf7ab5b659a5ea2d0c8c9.gif[/img]

This version is not polished and have some bugs, glitches and lack of some content from the main game. Here is a list of known issues and some tips.

[h3]Bugs and Issues we know about and working on:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Using [b]VirtualDesktop?[/b] Check [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1294760/discussions/4/3118160027731529602/]this thread[/url] to make it work.
[*] Texts in Menu are not texts.
[*] Only button-controlled magazine removal, no mag-hit-mag reloads or even hand reload. Only on button.
[*] Guns are unbalanced, hands on the handles may not fit into poses correctly.
[*] Hand pose may glitch and get unresponsive if enemy body disappeared when you were holding it —  restart the scene from Pause Menu.
[*] [strike]Streaming Camera may glitch on SteamVR devices and show 3D artefacts[/strike] FIXED
[*] Some guns may share same sounds.
[*] No gun stealing from enemy holsters.
[*] [strike]Enemies have issues with hand poses when holding guns.[/strike] FIXED
[*] Various sound glitches.
[*] Objects in Lobby may glitch and have strange weights.
[/list]
[h3]Mechanics from main Hard Bullet game that are not here yet:[/h3]
[list]
[*] No Dismemberment.
[*] No Disctructible objects.
[*] Basic enemy AI.
[*] No two-handed grab for pistols.
[*] Magazines are not physical.
[*] No wall jumps.
[*] No Music on arenas.
[*] Lack of sounds in general.
[*] No Break-action weapons.
[*] No brutal machines exept Grinder and Loader.
[*] No cuts, only piercing.
[*] Baths and Action in blockout state, no Kowloon, no Office.
[*] No Wave/Endless system.
[*] No Custom Ammo and Toy Soldiers.
[*] Lack of most options.
[/list]
[h3]Tips & Hints for better experience in PhysicsBeta[/h3]
If you're getting such hand glitch, probably your controllers are out of range. Get them first and then put on your VR helmet.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/fb42835b7655af7c822747eb96a3122c79aaba83.gif[/img]

Check the settings on launch, you can select a different Grip function (stick guns or press grip constantly).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/36772a92d93d17255c46b412eb71449b75cc0b91.png[/img]

In the Graphics you can set blood effect to be more realistic and make blood puddles effect stay forever — that will [b]increase your CPU calculations[/b], so be carefull. You can turn them off anytime in the Settings during the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/fb15907c473420716246ae9dd8a9e8f32a59c968.png[/img]

Well in Baths arena do not respawn player and do not kill bots who fall there. Use Pause Menu to respawn.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/1d2db6a111db3ad2e137764082427675cb4d0e4e.png[/img]

[h2]Your feedback and ideas[/h2]
As we start this Physics open beta, we count on your will to improve Hard Bullet and make it one of the best physics games out there.

We want to hear what you think about everything that happens, your ideas about future level design, weapons and enemy interactions. Find together the best ways to apply all these new possibilities that new Hard Bullet brings.

Use [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1294760/discussions/4/]Steam Forums[/url] or join our [url=https://www.discord.gg/QDrUWsJ]Discord[/url] to stay in touch and talk directly to the developers!

[b]Thank you all for your support, your comments, and for waiting for so long for this milestone — your belief in our small team helps us to move further![/b]

[h1]🔧How to switch to Beta[/h1]

[b]Importnat:[/b] after switching to beta it will wipe the current Steam version so you'll have to download it again if you want to get back to old experience.

[list]
[*] Go to Steam and find [b]Hard Bullet[/b] in there.
[*] Click with your [b]Right Mouse Button[/b] and select [b]Propreties[/b].
[*] Go to [b]Beta tab[/b] and in drop-down list [b]select PhysicsBeta[/b].
[*] After this [b]download of 6Gb[/b] will start.
[*] Run game from Steam, [b]no need for SteamVR if you use Oculus devices[/b].
[*] That's it! have fun!
[/list]

[b]If you want to go back to old version, just go to Beta tab in Properties and select None. it will initiate a download of old version.[/b]

notes.notes:
[h2]Upcoming: Kowloon City Arena[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/8d7be2e53d457f3d6189b9020b186446f2ee5202.jpg[/img]

[b]With this new area we want to showcase how Hard Bullet game will look soon. [/b]

A lot of time you'll spend on these dangerous Hong Kong streets so better be prepared. Very soon you'll discover this new arena and get some taste of the upcoming fights!

[b]Kowloon Arena with some overall game improvements and fixes will come this April.[/b]

[h2]New Physics and Player's Body Progress[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/3aeb93c41f5b2a15917a97ab28d95f0e1168e4aa.gif[/img]

Almost finished building this new physics body.

[b]Rewoked and built from the ground new body[/b] that adjusts to any height and totally eliminates lots of old annoying bugs:

[list]
[*] No stutter when you run into a wall or any other static object.
[*] Hands do not stuck in small or thin objects anymore.

notes.title: Big Gun Update: Firearms Reworked
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/42052abc8b7981432bbd6eee759022abbaa06641.gif[/img]

[h2]Realistic Firerate and Recoil[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/836def5c276b5554c048aedc6ab0ee0b68bcd3a3.gif[/img]

[b]Happy to introduce you new gun physics system we've been working on. Some things changed a lot, got new layers and mechanics, so you may need to get used to them.[/b]

[h3]Firerate[/h3]
Now the breechblock on every gun moves according to the real physics and moves the bullet into the barrel. The process inside the barrel is not visualised yet — we'll get there eventually.

This is a big improvement that brings us ability to control and tune the firerate of every gun in the game.

[h3]Recoil[/h3]
As we have breechblock simulation now, we have a new force to handle with — recoil. Every gone now reacts accordingly it's bullet type and firerate, so keep your hands on them to stabilize and controll where you shoot.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/17d21d6aa257e344ee68653af29b1a75c4d00158.gif[/img]

[h3]Gamedesigner's dream comes true[/h3]
The system we created is a very very customizable so these are not the final solutions and final gun behaviours. 

Expect often updates in guns physics cause now we can change it on the go and no need to wait for next big updates! 

While we'll be bringing back all Hard Bullet guns during next weeks, be ready for small updates in gun balance and please, leave your feedback on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1294760/discussions/3/]Forums[/url] or [url=https://www.discord.gg/QDrUWsJ]Discord[/url].

[h2]Shotgun Reloading[/h2]
We always wanted to bring badass shotgun reloads like in [b]Punisher[/b] or [b]Terminator[/b] to VR and here we are — reloading our shotguns with one hand in [b]Hard Bullet[/b]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/7c4aee97688c290ed93c6460b0965c8f87ee27fd.gif[/img]

Right now we are using a special control scheme to prevent accidential discharging. To let the pump move, you need to [b]press and hold trigger[/b] during this reloading process. Pump won't move even if you shot the shell.

We are working on a second solution that brings classic pavlov-like pump that is blocked only if the shell is inside the barrel back to Hard Bullet. When this option will be added, you'll be able to select the way you want pump to handle.

Shotguns now shoot with several shots (pellets) so they have greately reduced range for dismemberment skills. This is more realistic and not so owerpowered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/8d067fc8ddc6dbfdef362e7551d2807e41856157.jpg[/img]

[h2]Off-hand grab[/h2]
Keep holding weapons for handguard to free you main hand. You can use other weapons, take pistol form your chest or just reload a mag.
https://youtu.be/rXritDDcSJs

[h2]Advanced Handguard[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/c88754af93e21aff4bc3f181e28f9035f5439723.jpg[/img]

Handguard now works the same way the hand weapons handles do. You may choose the best place to lay your hand on. But only one. 
Would be really cool to add a second hand grab too, we'll definetely look into this one day.

[h2]Break Action Firearms[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/28bd10d4b910e00022d53b8925aaeb7382f925f6.gif[/img]

Press Drop Magazine Button to open the barrels and you'll be able to put bullets inside. 
Enjoy this bad boy while we are working on sawed-off and two barrel beauties.

[h2]Tactic is now Default[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/87a0d643f55fb2f3982dc232264d66bc37cf55ae.jpg[/img]

While we still looking for the best solution for Arcade mode, we made Tactical the default one.

If you switch back to Arcade, it will affect only your reloading — guns will still get autoreloaded when you move them near your waist (as before), but you'll need to move the breechblock by your hand to move the bullet inside the barrel.

You can perform tactical reloads to avoid this issue.

[h2]Force Feedback[/h2]
Guns feel new not only in VR but in real life too!
We added long-awaited force feedback to firearms types. This is a thing that will get improved and tuned overtime as new guns being added.

Right now you can set the strength or turn it off in the Settings Menu:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/b4a8c57387768d0520eb099eac111ffa08f4a6f3.jpg[/img]

[h2]Demo Updated[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/35340777e149fb0af1a1760d223d7a9e8a795151.png[/img]

Added all these awesome features into Demo version. [b]And removed AI opponents.[/b] We can't have both righ now, so stay tuned for further Demo updates and enjoy new physics!

If you want to remember how cool was just play Demo and kill enemies like an awesome action hero for zero pay, you can go to our [url=https://www.discord.gg/QDrUWsJ]Discord[/url] and get yourself a [b]beta code[/b] that unlocks old version from 2020.

Or better just go buy Hard Bullet to support the development! It's not easy, you know.

[h2]UPD from 02/06[/h2]

Rolled out a couple of important things today according to your feedback.

[b]Changed handle positions for each controller type and for every gun[/b]. Should be easier to reload pistols and some rifles. 
Please, leave your feedback so we can learn more and use it during upcoming Player's Body rework.

[b]Arcade mode got important updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Pistols and SGMs:[/b] mag drops when gets empty. Autoreload works like it used to so [b]you can go dual wielding[/b].
[*] [b]Rifles:[/b] You need to fix the breechlock before shoot again after doing autoreload.
[*] [b]Shotguns:[/b] Autoreload works the same but you need to pull the pump every time. That's why we have those awesome [b]onehanded reloads[/b]!
[/list]

[h2]Other Changes and Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [strike]Guns you drop will disappear in 15 seconds if not taken again.[/strike] — ok, ok, they are immortal again.
[*] Removed "baby shotgun" bug. There is a voting on the Discord to leave it in the game — join and tell us what do you think!
[*] Nailgun is back in business. And have endless nails. Have fun.
[/list]

[h2]Known issues[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/fd189c1964c85d90322a70dca52806f4b1b18ca8.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Made inactive some guns. Bringing them back during next weeks. 
[*] When performing reload with your main hand, magazines disappear from your waist [b]— fix in work[/b]. 
[*] Buttstock on Gal and MiniGal stopped poping up when grabbed with both hands.
[/list]

[h2]What's Next[/h2]
During February we plan to do couple of things and get to the player's body physics.

Player's body here is not just a model but the way you move, how you grab and hold weapons, your holsters and even that annoying Pause Menu — all these things will be reworked in [b]Player Body Update[/b] we'll start working on after we:
[list]
[*] Add all the guns that were in Hard Bullet before and add new break action models.
[*] Add new VFX we prepared.
[*] Seasonal Update for Lunar New year.
[*] Arenas refreshment.
[*] Add more melee stuff and maybe some new experimental weapons.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/8eb3f7bdabfb960e490fa8682ed8c0c96944f0c6.jpg[/img]
[b]New hand physics[/b] bring a whole new mechanic to the game — melee fights are bloody and gory as never before!

Prepare to [b]cut through your enemies[/b], pierce them with spears and pitchforks, cut with shovels, knives, machetes and traditional chineese swords to cut off thier heads!

Use [b]taser baton[/b] or nailed bat to calm most annoying amd don't forget to put some guys on sharp spikes. Big arsenal right from your garage workshop: hammers, [b]rusty pipes[/b] and other familiar instruments.

You also can use metal parts of your weapon to [b]block enemy bullets[/b]!

[b]We returned elbows to player[/b], so you can do more hits and deal more damage in melee fights. We plan to expand this side of Hard Bullet gameplay too so expect more fighting mechanics in the future. 


[h2]New Enemy Behaviour and Physics[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/8b91085a171c696ce7212aceed1c8cdbcdb87262.gif[/img]

[b]New body physics setup[/b] that allows us make more complex things and expand interactions with enemies. Now they not just weak puppets.

Bots now can take a hit, react to bullets and get up more naturally. We added some [b]new punches and kicks animations[/b] with empty hands so watch fists fly into your face... or be ready to block them!

Prepare yourself for [b]new gory effects[/b] like blood streams from wounds, cleave wounds on bodies and new inner textures. Blowing heads and other limb coming next!

[b]Improved the grab system[/b], so nothing prevents you from touching them! And yep, now they look at you when get closer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/11236804034d694c5aaa7146898d4ce313407ed2.gif[/img]

To say more, [b]we updated and rigged the whole model again[/b]. Just keep in mind, this models are EA temporary anyway.  

A lot more to come to make your interactions easier and enemies look and sound more realistic, so stay tuned!

Lots of annoying things left, however, new physics brings us new bugs, please, report anything gamebraking you spot!

[*] [b]Cutting[/b]. You can chop and cut enemies with different types of bladed weapons. New effect — leave bleeding cuts or chop off their limbs!
[*] [b]Nailgun[/b]. Use this to stick bad guys to the walls. We have plans to add other variations of this gun in the future!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/0a28c9057c991e5ebf78253b84b0e97cee3b58db.jpg[/img]
This progress we have with new hands will help us bring some cool interactions sooner than we planned, so expect lots of new handy things in the future updates!

[h2]Body Physics Update[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/11236804034d694c5aaa7146898d4ce313407ed2.gif[/img]

Totally new physics setup for all enemy bodies. Now every meele fight becomes much more complex due to new limbs weight, updated rig and animations.

Bots now can take a hit, react to bullets and get up more naturally. We added some new punches and kicks animations with empty hands so watch fists fly into your face... or be ready to block them! 

Returned player's elbows, so you can hit with them again!

We want to bring more meele interactions in the future, so, please, share your thoughts and ideas with us.

[h2]Bladed and Blunt weapons[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/0bc9f4db65436baae7a1cb9871c59159b1d0fe42.jpg[/img]
[i]notice: only some of new weapons shown above[/i]

Still working out the final list, cause we decided to add more chinese weapons than generic european ones. Everything we mentioned before is already there, so expect cool surprises on launch!

[h2]Multi-Language Translation[/h2]
Hard Bullet is avaliable on 10 languages and we will add more. With this update we welcome:

notes.title: Closed Beta Content Update
notes.notes:
This is the first Closed Beta update. We plan to make minor and big updates and add some experimental features during the development.

Please, joint our [url=https://discord.gg/QDrUWsJ]Discord[/url] to get the access! 

[h1]New Enemies[/h1]
[h2]Ultra-Heavy Soldier[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/1fa111f4ac661ef757b486f6f9a8fe69fba064ce.gif[/img]

A tough guy with a heavy gun. 
Has a lot oh HP and thick armor. You cannot hit or move him.
However, no custom animations for now and the model do not show the damage yet.

[h2]Baton Fighters[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/0cad993821507a69fc96007a07b61bf85b9d0537.gif[/img]

Actually there is no special model cause every regular enemy can now attack with a baton or gun.
If an enemy looses his gun, he takes out his baton and hits pretty well with it. No, you can't take it yet.

[h2]AI Improvements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/268c23f7258700d362d50c5d4933f8c7578c3e64.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Enemies try to hit you if you get too close.
[*] Now enemies have a near death state when they panic and run into cover. Not included into beta yet.
[/list]

[h1]Gore and Dismemberment[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/6b730c470cb693d8795a0c9dae8438afc36382e5.gif[/img]

Added dismemberment. 
We have big plans on adding procedural damage for all flesh and a possibility to destroy the body completely. 
We will return to this very important tasks a little later, after some groundbraking updates for puppets are made.

[h2]Guns[/h2]
[h3]New gun parameters[/h3]
Reworked the damage system and changed the core parameters for all guns.
Please, leave your feedback about the new magazines and shooting speed of some models.

[h3]Enemies' guns[/h3]
Now all the enemies have the same gun that you have. You can shoot them off their hands and take them for yourself.

[h3]Test Guns[/h3]
There are a few cool-looking gold guns. They do lots of damage and shoot off limbs immediately. Just for fun.

[h2]New Music[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548791/3e5322e6a7051ee3fdd7da82d74eb31dce9e807f.jpg[/img]
Added 10 new music tracks as a temporary playlist.
As usual, we work hard on game soundtrack and all the sounds, we hope to make some major sound updates during this month.

[h2]Perfomance in Closed Beta[/h2]
All these awesome features hit the perfomance so we decided to remove some objects and furniture from the scene.

Will return it after we finish all the update that involve perfomance.
